scenario_formulas.initial_classify_steps: initial_sessions (completed guide classification OR direct intake, not both in nominal successful path)
scenario_formulas.native_API_requests_assumed: find_sources_steps * (1 + native_pause_continuations_per_source_request), where pause continuations <=2 inside one custom execute
scenario_formulas.SDK_regular_fast_max_tokens: 64,000 model default in installed SDK when no explicit task output limit; not measured actual output
scenario_formulas.native_raw_API_max_tokens: 1,024 explicit per HTTP body; source API is not the SDK default64K
scenario_formulas.retry_code_bound_scope: For fixed assumed triggers only; source framework-eligible schema reexecution factor2 conservative, ordinary source HTTP/JSON error shapes generally do not enter schema retry. Guide client exceptions/reopen/refresh can add triggers outside this bound.

parameterized_cost_formulas.native_search_fee_usd: actual_provider_reported_web_search_requests*10/1000; add actual text usage separately, once
parameterized_cost_formulas.overall_usd: sum(unique leaf FAST cost estimates) + sum(unique leaf CARD estimates if model/price/usage verified) + native search fee + voice estimates if tariff/usage verified; if required component unknown, total=null and show known partial with coverage
parameterized_cost_formulas.cache_convention: Provider input_tokens/cache tokens must be interpreted by provider semantics to avoid double counting; separate cache creation durations when reported. Cache result reuse does not re-add old token usage.
parameterized_cost_formulas.missing_usage_convention: If any required counter missing, total unknown; do not multiply characters by an invented ratio. Reservation uses verified model hard context/output upper limits, not estimated actual tokens.

economics_existing_vs_proposed.existing_fact: A fire-and-forget ping per first model/process before task execution adds another potential provider request and is absent from ai_runs.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.proposal: Use first actual task response for model/config health or a non-billable supported health check instead of background ping.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.quality_control: Task prompt/output unchanged; verify errors still surface with fallback.

economics_existing_vs_proposed.existing_fact: assist_tone returns undefined for <3 words only after a provider call.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.proposal: Move the identical <3-word deterministic condition before model invocation.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.quality_control: For this exact condition, post-validation already fixes the output to undefined; test equivalence on multilingual whitespace/input.

economics_existing_vs_proposed.existing_fact: No atomic in-flight dedup or journey shared reservation; cache miss races and stale UI work possible.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.proposal: One active request per authorized context/version with coalescing; preserve latest need during cooldown and enforce shared money/tool ledger.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.scope: targeted service boundary, no generic agent/vector platform
economics_existing_vs_proposed.quality_control: Corrections replace prior need; old result never overwrites new context; stop next requests on AI off or closed panel.

economics_existing_vs_proposed.existing_fact: Library cache uses normalized need+org+locale without semantic context/source version/expiry; unmeasured hit does not prove useful material.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.proposal: Cache eligible source passages with source/release version; result reuse additionally depends on authorized semantic intent/context.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.quality_control: Same pronoun under different corrected context must retrieve fitting material, not stale result.

economics_existing_vs_proposed.existing_fact: FAST SDK defaults max_tokens64K; native source API explicitly1024. Schema/output validation alone does not cap financial output.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.proposal: Choose per-task output/input/tool caps after same-quality tests, timeout and fallback; avoid silent truncation of a religious qualification.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.scope: provider boundary after review; temporary probe cap1024 never produced a successful task here
economics_existing_vs_proposed.quality_control: Model result completeness, source conditions and false fallback rate must not worsen; retry budget is shared.

economics_existing_vs_proposed.existing_fact: TTS is separate, up to2 API attempts, no AI-switch/rate/usage, mute may allow late playback.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.proposal: Org AI gate plus context/request ID, one current audio request, repeat suppression and voice-character usage independent of text tokens.
economics_existing_vs_proposed.quality_control: Preserve accessibility and voice choice; late audio never starts after mute; do not assume shared cache safe for personalized questions.
